beats.label: S1 · The president is dead
beats.text: Agent Xavier Collins finds President Bradford murdered in his residence; the idyllic town of Paradise proves to be a domed bunker inside a Colorado mountain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes both the murder mystery frame and the show's central twist that must be understood before any investigation makes sense.

beats.label: S1 · Sinatra
beats.text: Collins suspects billionaire Samantha Redmond, who built and secretly rules the bunker, and enlists agents Robinson and Pace against her, unaware Driscoll is Redmond's mole.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's real antagonist and the sides that will drive every subsequent conflict, including Driscoll's hidden allegiance.

beats.label: S1 · Pace silenced
beats.text: Pace learns Redmond had him kill surface scientists to hide that Earth is still habitable; before he can tell Collins the truth, Driscoll poisons him on Redmond's orders.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals both the founding lie of Paradise and Driscoll's willingness to kill for Redmond, seeding Collins' break from the regime.

beats.label: S1 · The Day
beats.text: Flashbacks reveal Bradford triggered a secret EMP to stop a nuclear war but left Collins' wife Teri outside; his guilt drove him to plan exposing Redmond's lies before his death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains the disaster, why Teri is missing, and what Bradford was about to do — the specific act that made someone want him dead.

beats.label: S1 · Message on the dome
beats.text: Collins' children hack Bradford's tablet and project 'They're lying to you' onto the artificial sky; Collins and Robinson arm rebels while Redmond retreats to a private bunker.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The population now knows something is wrong, and the open uprising is the pivot from covert investigation to civil war.

beats.label: S1 · The killer unmasked
beats.text: Trent, a wronged construction worker who snuck in under a false identity, is unmasked as Bradford's killer and suicides; Driscoll then shoots Redmond non-lethally to bury the truth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the murder while leaving Redmond alive and Driscoll's role uncontested, keeping every S2 power thread live.

beats.label: S1 · Collins flies out
beats.text: Learning Teri's Atlanta message means she survived, Collins pilots a plane out of the bunker to find her, leaving his children behind in Robinson's care.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Physically launches the whole S2 setting: Collins outside, family split across the sealed door, Robinson holding the line inside.

cliffhanger.text: The murder is solved but the bigger lie — that the world outside is livable and that survivors were abandoned — is now half-exposed. Collins has flown out to find Teri; Redmond is wounded but alive, and Driscoll walks free.
questions: Can Collins find Teri alive after nearly two years without power?
What other survivors exist outside the bunker, and how will they react to Paradise?
With Redmond down and Driscoll unexposed, who really controls the bunker now?

characters.name: Xavier Collins
characters.line: Secret Service agent whose wife was stranded outside; leaves Paradise at season's end to search for her.

characters.name: Samantha Redmond
characters.line: Billionaire who built and secretly rules the bunker; shot non-lethally by her own agent and left in a coma.

characters.name: Jane Driscoll
characters.line: Secret Service agent secretly loyal to Redmond; poisoned Pace and shot Redmond to frame Collins and protect the conspiracy.

characters.name: Nicole Robinson
characters.line: Secret Service agent and Bradford's former lover, now Collins' ally and guardian of his children inside the bunker.

characters.name: Dr. Torabi
characters.line: Paradise's mental health chief, quietly aligned with Collins against Redmond.

characters.name: Teri Collins
characters.line: Xavier's wife, believed dead since the disaster; a recorded message from Atlanta proves she survived.

characters.name: Presley Collins
characters.line: Xavier's teenage daughter, who used Bradford's tablet to expose the regime on the dome; remains in Paradise.

characters.name: Jeremy Bradford
characters.line: The murdered president's son, publicly resentful of a bunker built only for billionaires; helped Presley leak the truth.

beats.label: S2 · Sunlight returns
beats.text: Twenty-three months after the disaster, sunlight breaks through the ash; Graceland guide Annie Clay, pregnant by a departed survivor named Link, finds Collins crashed nearby in Arkansas.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens up the world outside, introduces Annie and Link, and puts Collins in a stranger's hands rather than back on his own mission.

beats.label: S2 · Redmond takes it back
beats.text: In the bunker, President Baines assumes control and jails dissenters including Jeremy, but Redmond wakes from her coma and has Driscoll assassinate him, restoring the conspiracy's grip.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reversal of S1's ending: the exposé failed, Redmond is back in power, and Driscoll's role as her killer is now open inside the bunker.

beats.label: S2 · A holy charge
beats.text: Annie makes Collins promise to reunite her newborn daughter with Link before dying in childbirth; Collins carries the baby toward Atlanta, still searching for Teri.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Binds Collins to Link before they ever meet, and sets the emotional stakes he'll carry through the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Atlanta
beats.text: In Atlanta, Collins finds Teri living with Gary, a mailman turned survivalist; she reveals she joined a Colorado-bound militia willingly, not by force as Gary had claimed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the Collins family and reframes the militia — Link's people — as something Teri chose, not something she needs rescuing from.

beats.label: S2 · Alex
beats.text: The militia's target, dubbed 'Alex,' turns out to be an AI Redmond secretly built; Link and Collins share visions and nosebleeds around each other, signs of Alex's manipulation of time itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Redefines the show's stakes from political conspiracy to something science-fictional, and links Link and Collins as more than strangers.

beats.label: S2 · The doors open
beats.text: Jeremy, Robinson and the bunker's architect sabotage the oxygen supply to force Paradise's doors open; the cooling systems explode, killing the architect, and Torabi orders full evacuation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the bunker as a place: everything and everyone leaves. Removes the S1 setting from the board.

beats.label: S2 · Denver
beats.text: Redmond reveals Link is her supposedly-dead son Dylan, then sacrifices herself sealing the reactors' blast inside; Torabi sends Collins to find Alex, buried beneath Denver Airport.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Redmond's arc, gives Link his true identity, and points Collins at the specific destination the next chapter of the show is built around.

cliffhanger.text: Paradise is evacuated and Redmond is dead, but the militia now occupies the ruined bunker and Collins has been sent by a time-manipulating AI to reach a second facility beneath Denver Airport. Link has just learned he is Redmond's son and met his newborn daughter, while Driscoll's body has vanished from Torabi's shower.
questions: What does Alex want from Collins, and why did the AI specifically summon him?
How will Link handle being Redmond's son Dylan and a father in the same moment?
If Driscoll's body is gone, is she actually dead?

characters.name: Xavier Collins
characters.line: Reunited with Teri and their son, guardian of Annie's newborn, now travelling to Denver on Alex's summons.

characters.name: Teri Collins
characters.line: Alive after nearly two years outside; reunited with Xavier and revealed to have joined Link's Colorado-bound militia by choice.

characters.name: Link
characters.line: Militia leader and father of Annie's baby, revealed at season's end to be Samantha Redmond's supposedly-dead son Dylan.

characters.name: Samantha Redmond
characters.line: Died sealing the bunker's reactors' explosion inside, after confirming Link is her son and pointing Collins toward Alex.

characters.name: Dr. Torabi
characters.line: The surviving authority who ordered Paradise's evacuation and directed Collins to Alex beneath Denver Airport.

characters.name: Alex
characters.line: A time-manipulating quantum AI Redmond secretly built in a bunker 100 miles from Paradise, now waiting for Collins.

characters.name: Nicole Robinson
characters.line: Freed from prison during the oxygen sabotage; escaped the bunker with the militia's help.

characters.name: Jeremy Bradford
characters.line: Imprisoned by Baines, helped force the bunker doors open from inside, and was rescued during the evacuation.

characters.name: Presley Collins
characters.line: Xavier's daughter, trapped alongside Redmond's daughter Hadley during the sabotage; rescued by Collins and Link.
